description: This source file defines the ApplicationService class, which extends AbstractService and manages application lifecycle events such as start, launch, syncs, and key changes. It sets up event observers and provides methods for handling these events, with hooks for subclasses to override.

classes.name: ApplicationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing application lifecycle events and their corresponding handlers, extending AbstractService.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ApplicationService with the application interface and event bus, sets up event observers after construction.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Performs cleanup by unsubscribing from events and calling the superclass deinitialization.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Schedules adding of app event observers after subclasses are fully constructed.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Registers an event observer on the application to handle different application lifecycle events.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Placeholder for handling generic application events; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Hook for handling app start event; override as needed.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Hook for handling app launch event; override as needed.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Hook for handling key status changes; override as needed.

methods.name: onAppIncrementalSync
methods.description: Hook for handling incremental sync completion; override as needed.

methods.name: onAppFullSync
methods.description: Hook for handling full sync completion; override as needed.
